thread:
Nora: Quick thought 4: food-truck + mini-trivia + optional karaoke on the plaza this Friday at sunset (6:45)? Bring a dollar for truck tipping if you can. :taco:
Chen: love it. what trucks are nearby? i can check the vendor list.
Diego: i'm down. trivia theme suggestion: '90s nostalgia or tech oddities?
Pri: i'd vote '90s nostalgia. karaoke after trivia? low-key, 10-15 min slots.
event-bot: Poll: React :one: for trivia + karaoke, :two: for trivia only, :three: for just food. Poll ends in 48h.
Nora: vendor note: there's a vegan taco truck and a dessert cart. Chen pls confirm menus.
Chen: confirmed: Tacos (meat/vegan), Bao, and a dessert cart with mini churros and vegan cookies.
Diego: I'll bring a small bluetooth speaker and mic. can someone volunteer to run trivia slides?
Pri: I can run slides. i have a 10-question set ready. keep it friendly and booze-free.
Nora: logistics: meet at plaza steps 6:30 for table setup, trucks arrive ~6:45. seating is limited.
Chen: capacity note: plaza seats ~40; RSVP so we don't overflow. i'll pin a small sheet: tiny.rw/plaza-trivia
Diego: karaoke volunteer: i can host after trivia if people are into it. short song sign-ups in the sheet.
Pri: prize idea: quirky stickers + a reusable food truck token for the winning team.
Nora: bless the stickers. also please label dishes for allergens; Chen can you ask vendors to provide allergen cards?
Chen: will do. vendors agreed to have simple allergen labels.
Diego: will bring a couple of foldable blankets for people who want to sit on the grass.
Pri: RSVP deadline Wednesday noon so we can confirm trivia team sizes.
event-bot: Reminder set for Wednesday 09:00: "Plaza food-truck trivia RSVP cutoff"
Nora: small ask: keep karaoke volume reasonable. it's an open plaza; we want to be good neighbors.
Chen: noted. also will bring hand sanitizer and napkins.
Diego: volunteers to help guide truck lines? need two people.
Pri: i can help for 20 minutes while I set up trivia.
Nora: thanks! i'll update the sheet with running order: trucks eat 6:45-7:30, trivia 7:45, karaoke 8:15 (optional).
Pri: excited. bringing team name ideas: 'The Tamagotchi Titans' anyone?
Diego: brilliant. see you Friday!
event-bot: Event created: "Twilight Plaza: Food Truck + Trivia + Karaoke" — volunteers list updated.
